metadata.title: Here Are the Nasdaq Stocks Getting Hit the Hardest Today

content.text:
Updated 18 hours ago
Here Are the Nasdaq Stocks Getting Hit the Hardest Today
It was a bloodbath out there for Nasdaq stocks. The Nasdaq Composite Index finished lower 5.3% and ended the week with a 10% tumble. Here were some of the hardest hit stocks in the index today.
